content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Agartala Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Agartala to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) to hire eligible candidates for temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIT Agartala?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Library Professional Trainee under the education field for dynamic and qualified individuals looking to build their professional careers.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Library Professional Trainee post, providing a great opportunity for qualified applicants.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Division in Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS) from a recognized Indian university to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 27 years, calculated as per the guidelines specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Library Professional Trainee position will receive a fixed monthly salary or stipend of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 16-10-2026. Candidates should apply early to avoid server congestion.

faq.question: Q8. Through which mode should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via online mode through the designated application portal provided by NIT Agartala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written or skill test followed by a personal interview to judge candidate capability.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website of the institute?
faq.answer: You can visit the official NIT Agartala website at www.nita.ac.in to access all relevant details and application guidelines.
